model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the negative log probability across several per-specialty terms for two models, MistralV0.2-Base and Fine-tuned. The horizontal axis represents the per-specialty terms—Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics—listed in alphabetical order. The vertical axis, labeled “Negative log probability,” has a linear scale ranging from -22 to -27, with tick marks at integer values. For each per-specialty term, there are two adjacent bars representing the negative log probability for each model: MistralV0.2-Base is shown in a lighter orange color, while the Fine-tuned model is represented by a darker orange. The bars are grouped by per-specialty term, with each grouping showing the two models side-by-side. The shortest bars are for the “Cardio” term, with the MistralV0.2-Base model bar reaching approximately -22.3 and the Fine-tuned model reaching -22.5.  The tallest bars are for the “Neuro” term, reaching approximately -23.2 for MistralV0.2-Base and -23.9 for Fine-tuned. No bars appear to be visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotations.
